description: The classic newground choose-your-own-adventure where failing is more fun than succeeding.

alpha1.description:
ITS FINALLY PLAYABLE WITH THE PUBLIC ARCHIPELAGO RELEASE LETSSS GOOOOOO

to install just replace the henry.swf in your Henry stickmin game with the one from here install the apworld and launch the Henry client it should auto detect your save path and just work but for some reason if it doesn't you can use /set_henry_path to provide a path to your Henry saves

make sure to use the "clear_save_data option" in game once you start or else you will have map access before you are suppose to
alpha1.title: Fixed AP World

alpha3.description:
built in recheck functionality to further reduce the probability of race conditions between the Henry game writing to the file and the Henry client clearing it 

also fixed a bug where the game wasn't clearing until getting a check after completing the goal

also also made it so you have the option to use Charles and reginalds phone numbers instead of just only making it possible when infiltrating the airship is turned off

also also also added some checking for if you specify you want to get more endings than possible, it will simply force you to get all endings possible in that case

next update will be completing the mission
alpha3.title: Bug Fixes and Improvements
